subject: ela
intro: A firsthand account is told by someone who was there and experienced the event; it often uses 'I' and includes personal feelings. A secondhand account is written by someone who was not there; it reports facts from research, usually in third person. Fourth graders tell the difference and compare the focus and information of each.

items.prompt:
Read.

'I will never forget the roar of the waves as I clung to the rail of our ship in the storm.'

Is this a firsthand or secondhand account?

steps: It uses 'I' and personal feelings from someone who was there.
So it is a firsthand account.

items.prompt:
Read.

'The storm of 1912 damaged many ships. Records show it lasted three days.'

Is this firsthand or secondhand?

steps: It reports facts from records, by someone not there, in third person.
So it is a secondhand account.

items.prompt: Which account usually includes the writer's personal FEELINGS: firsthand or secondhand?

steps: A firsthand account comes from someone who felt the experience.

items.prompt: An account using 'I saw' and personal feelings is ____.
An account based on research by someone not there is ____.
Firsthand accounts often use the word ____.
